results.detail: verify.ps1 built all targets and passed all four local test executables, including hibiki_contract_tests with the new Issue 1303 crash report fixtures (SHA-256 known vectors, ring eviction, redaction leak check, canonical round-trip, and fail-closed parser rejections).
handoff-check #1303 (claimed ownership, scope and Git state), docs-check (88 required paths), source-policy (728 tracked paths), and git diff --check all exited 0 in the isolated worktree.

limitations: Evidence covers the user-space bounded crash report store contract only: entry schema validation, fixed-capacity oldest-first eviction, canonical JSON serialization, strict fail-closed parsing, and SHA-256 digest generation for module identity redaction.

It does not demonstrate a live worker crash being captured into the store, minidump capture, symbol resolution, production worker policy integration, WaveRT delivery, driver installation, HLK validation, or signing.
The provenance digest binds this manifest to the staged SPEC-0008, contract-test and vst-host source set; it does not independently attest that declared commands ran.
